says: A Team adopted an environment's first edition. Alice opened a link to her host session, composed the session's start from that adoption - the owner returned the preparation and recorded the session selected only - and then activated the session with it; the activation returned the projection of the rules unit beside the routing, and an observation shows the rules and knowledge units that arrived on that link. The Team then authors a checklist source, publishes a newer edition that adds its pin on the environment's current edition, and adopts it; the adoption commits and returns only the adoption record. Observing Alice's session again still names her existing preparation and the same two units: the adoption changed neither her preparation nor what her session received. A preparation composed from the newer adoption names that adoption and adds the checklist unit, but nothing has activated a session with it, so observing it writes and returns no delivery observation at all. The adoption record must never be returned or read as a delivery to any recipient.
